title: The AI Price War Just Got Brutal
script: OpenAI didn’t just clap back. It started a price war. One week after Claude Fable 5.2, OpenAI launched Astra and Sol. Astra is for heavy work: docs, slides, code, even 3D frontends. Sol is the faster, cheaper everyday model. Astra: eight dollars in, forty out per million tokens. Sol: two dollars in, ten out. That’s not just a benchmark win. It’s market pressure. The real winner might be anyone who can now afford powerful AI.
cta: Follow AI Tested for the next model war move.
